item.title: The Legend of Zelda live-action film starts filming, first three images
item.description: Nintendo has confirmed the start of filming for the live-action The Legend of Zelda film, as well as released the first three images.

item.title: Marble run and racing simulation game Cozy Marbles announced for PC
item.description: Publisher Mythwright and developer Pixel Pea Games have announced marble run and racing simulation game Cozy Marbles for PC (Steam). It will launch in 2026. A playtest is available now.
